דאמר מר (30b.12) -- an unnamed master whose dictum the stam cites
Hoshea ben Elah, king of Israel, whose words Ulla reports (31a.1)
רבי אליעזר הגדול, in the baraita (31a.3)

props.gloss_en: what then is [the joy of] 15 Av? Shmuel: the day the tribes were permitted to enter one another [in marriage]
what did they expound? 'this is the matter which the Lord commanded concerning the daughters of Zelophehad' (Num 36:6) -- this matter shall apply only in this generation
Rav Nachman: the day the tribe of Benjamin was permitted to enter the congregation
as it says: 'and the men of Israel swore in Mizpah, saying: none of us shall give his daughter to Benjamin as a wife' (Judg 21:1)
what did they expound? Rav: 'of us' -- and not of our children
R' Yochanan: the day on which the dead of the wilderness came to an end
as the master said: until the dead of the wilderness came to an end there was no [divine] speech with Moshe
as it says: 'and it came to pass when all the men of war were finished dying... the Lord spoke to me' (Deut 2:16-17) -- [only then] to me was the speech
Ulla: the day Hoshea ben Elah abolished the guards that Jeroboam ben Nevat had set on the roads so that Israel would not go up for the festival
and [Hoshea] said: let them go up to whichever [place] they wish
Rav Mattana: the day the slain of Beitar were given for burial
and Rav Mattana said: on the day the slain of Beitar were given for burial they instituted in Yavne 'who is good and does good'
'who is good' -- that they did not decay
'and does good' -- that they were given for burial
Rabba and Rav Yosef both: the day they stopped cutting wood for the altar-pile
R' Eliezer the Great: from 15 Av onward the strength of the sun wanes
and they would not cut wood for the altar-pile, because it does not dry
Rav Menashya: and they called it the day of the breaking of the scythe
from here on: one who adds -- will add; and one who does not add -- will be gathered
what is 'will be gathered'? Rav Yosef: his mother will bury him
